scripts.dev:all: npm run server & npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.image:publish: docker start local-registry >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker run -d -p 5000:5000 --restart=always --name local-registry registry:2 && docker tag 007remix:local localhost:5000/007remix:local && docker push localhost:5000/007remix:local
scripts.once:deploy: npm run image:build && npm run image:publish && once deploy localhost:5000/007remix:local --host 007remix.localhost --disable-tls
scripts.once:update: npm run image:build && npm run image:publish && once update 007remix.localhost --image localhost:5000/007remix:local
